Le 08. 06. 10 17:07, azadeh falsafian a écrit :
 
Dear Mr. Stigler
I am a Ph.D. student in agricultural Economics. My thesis is on “Asymmetric Price Transmission” in agrifood prices. Currently I am doing my thesis by your package” tsDyn”.
great. Hope it will help you! Which university?
We have applied Hansen & Seo (2002)’s threshold Cointagration test. I think the HanSeo_TVECM() function currently does not available in “tsDyn” new version. May I please ask you send me any copy or draft of R CODE of “tsDyn:::HanSeo_TVECM() function.
type simply the name of the function in R terminal:
tsDyn:::HanSeo_TVECM

Or download source code from R.

Note that the reason it is not exported to the user is that it will be rewritten soon (1-3 months) to be more conform to R concepts.
In addition, we are using Lo & Zivot (2002)’s threshold TVECM test. To getting the p-value, I bootstrap the VECM and TVECM with three regimes by TVECM.sim() function and estimate the VECM and TVECM(3) with bootstrapped series again by TVECM() function. Then I calculate LR test statistic. I repeat above procedure 1000 time manually to calculate the p-value. Since, I must do this procedure for 5 bivariate prices series to test threshold Cointagration test and also to test 1 threshold against 2 threshold TVECM models, it is take a lot of time and maybe I get some mistakes. It would be grateful if you help me, how I could automatically replicate 1000 times by some programming in R package to calculate the p-values.
See function TVECM.sim which should do what you want. If you have a dual-quad core, to reduce time, I would suggest to use the nice foreach package.
It would my high appreciate if you possibly help me. My deadline is going to end and I am looking forward to hearing from you.
King Regards,
Good luck for your thesis. When people use the package, I really appreciate is my work can be cited appropriately (see BibTex ref to the vignette in CRAN), as well as if people send a copy of the thesis, to build up a "collection" of academic work done with the package. 

PS: please copy to the mailing list at googlegroups
 Azadeh Falsafian.
